summary: A template change no longer holds up a whole update.

fixes.title: Code updates go ahead despite template changes
fixes.text: When a release changes templates you use, the code update now goes ahead. Only the template change waits for an administrator to accept it on the Template releases page.

fixes.title: A failed database step retries itself
fixes.text: If the database setup fails during an update, the update is still held, but the failure is reported and the next update tries again. Nobody has to act.

fixes.title: Updates behave the same everywhere
fixes.text: Updates behave the same whatever protection level your installation's guards have.
